text:
people-ops-bot: :loudspeaker: New hire inbound — please welcome Ash Sinha, joining Redwood Inference as Senior Manager, Platform Operations, start date 2024-06-03.
Maya Patel: woohoo 🎉 thrilled to have you, Ash. You'll be owning cross-team runbooks, incident readiness for Dedicated, and the capacity handoff.
Ash Sinha: excited to join the team — thanks Maya! looking forward to meeting folks and digging into the Dedicated capacity playbook.
Diego Morales: welcome Ash! quick note — we'll pair on the Dedicated capacity on-call rotation next week. can you do Thu 10am PT? @Ash Sinha
Ash Sinha: Thu 10am PT works for me.
Lizzy Mendoza: adding Ash to the org chart and benefits invite now. @Ash Sinha can you confirm your preferred pronouns and timezone? also slack handle? :slightly_smiling_face:
Ash Sinha: pronouns he/him, timezone PDT. slack: @ash.sinha
Priya Natarajan: tagging the hiring thread for the Platform Ops IC backfill — we want to start interviews this quarter. owner: Priya. I'll post the scorecard later today.
Maya Patel: handoff notes: async runbook location https://redwood.internal/runbooks/platform-ops; scope doc: https://redwood.internal/wiki/platform-ops/scope. key weekly syncs: capacity review (Mon 9am PT), postmortem review (Fri 3pm PT).
Ash Sinha: thanks — I've skimmed the runbook. small question: who currently owns the Dedicated throughput benchmarks? Maya?
Maya Patel: yes, currently me. I'll transfer the dashboard ownership and alerts to you before your start. checklist below:
```
- transfer Grafana dashboard ownership
- update pager rota
- add Ash to AWS accounts
- schedule 1:1 with Diego and Priya
- invite to Dedicated runbook edits
```
Diego Morales: will do the 1:1 invites after you accept the calendar. Also FYI there will be a capacity review with a partner customer on 6/10 — would love you to sit in.
Ash Sinha: happy to join the 6/10 customer review.
Lizzy Mendoza: onboarding plan shared: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/ash-sinha — includes equipment, security training, and the Welcome Lunch invite. :bento:
people-ops-bot: Reminder: new hire paperwork due 2024-05-30. link: https://hr.redwood.internal/newhire
Priya Natarajan: hiring update: posting for Platform Ops IC role goes live tomorrow. if anyone wants to refer, DM me. :rocket:
Maya Patel: quick ask — Ash, can you prioritize the Dedicated SLA runbook first 2 weeks? it's the highest risk area.
Ash Sinha: will do. thanks everyone — looking forward to working with you all. :wave:
